messages:
Priya: FYI — Sam handed in a resignation today, last day Fri 2026-04-18. Need a staggered deprovision plan so we don't accidentally block ongoing work. Can we outline who does what and timing? :wave:
Alex M: Thanks for flagging. My ask: keep product and CI access until noon on final day, revoke VPN/SSO around 15:00 after final handoff. Team leads should confirm no active deploys past 13:00.
Maya-IT: I can own the execution. Proposed steps:
1) 12:00 - set Slack status to "Alumni - in transition" -> manual
2) 13:00 - remove org-level repo write, keep read-only
3) 15:00 - deactivate Okta + GSuite + VPN
4) 15:05 - rotate any AWS keys and revoke personal roles
Commands I'll run (for audit):
```
# Okta & GSuite
oktactl deactivate-user --user sam
gsuite-admin suspend_user sam@redwood.com
# AWS keys
aws iam list-access-keys --user-name sam
aws iam update-access-key --user-name sam --access-key-id <KEY> --status Inactive
```
Jorge: Security note — if Sam has any long-lived service keys or uses any shared service accounts, we must rotate affected credentials immediately after deprovision. Also export audit logs for the last 30 days and attach to the offboard ticket. Ping me when you start so I can validate.
Kelsey: Benefits/info: COBRA packet is queued to go out automatically on 2026-04-19 (HR system). Final benefits coverage date is 2026-04-30. COBRA enrollment window is 60 days from notification; I emailed the standard packet to Sam just now (cc Priya). Will follow up if they don't complete enrollment within 7 days.
Priya: I created the offboard checklist in Notion and shared with Sam + Alex M — link pasted in the calendar invite. Exit interview scheduled 2026-04-20 10:00 with Kelsey (inv sent). Sam, please upload the knowledge-transfer doc to the shared folder before EOD Thu.
Sam: Uploaded a short runbook and list of outstanding tickets here: https://drive.redwood.com/handovers/sam-runbook.pdf. Leaving notes on two active PRs and a small migration that should be scheduled for after I'm gone. Happy to hop on a quick handoff session.
Alex M: I reviewed the runbook — looks good. We'll schedule a 30-min handoff Wed 16:00. No deploys after Thu 13:00, please.
Maya-IT: Confirmed. I'll run the deprovision timeline and post completion proof in this thread. ETA for commands: 2026-04-18 15:00 UTC. Will attach syslog snippets to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
IT-bot: Reminder — please create an offboard ticket in JIRA using template OFFBOARD-NEW. Link to ticket: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/OFFBOARD-2345
Priya: Courier label for laptop return created and emailed to Sam. Sam — please drop the device at the labeled UPS store or hand it to People Ops.
Jorge: After deprovisioning, I'll run a quick credential audit and confirm no remaining access. I'll also add a note to the security playbook if we find any odd entitlements.
Kelsey: One more: final paycheck & PTO payout will process on 2026-04-25. Sam, HR team will send tax paperwork if needed.
Sam: Thanks everyone — appreciate the clear plan. I'll be available for the handoff session and will ship the laptop by Thu morning.
Maya-IT: Done with checklist. Will post audit logs and command outputs here after run.
Priya: Closing loop — I'll mark the offboard ticket complete once we have confirmation from Maya and Jorge and Sam confirms laptop received by HR. Thanks all. :pray:
